```{r}
library(TSA)
library(rugarch)
```

```{r}
#simular
simula_garch11 <- function(omega = 0.01, alpha = 0.059739, beta = 0.813572,
                           n = 10000, skip = 1000){
  n <- n+skip
  r <- rep(0,n)
  sigma2 <- rep(0,n)
  sigma2[1] <- 1
  epsilon <- rnorm(n)
  for(i in 2:n){
    sigma2[i] <- omega + alpha*r[i-1]^2 + beta*sigma2[i-1]
    r[i] <- sqrt(sigma2[i])*epsilon[i]
  }
  
  return(r[(seq(1,n)+skip)])
}

serie = simula_garch11(n = 1000) |> na.omit()
```

```{r}
#ugarch
spec <- ugarchspec(mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(1, 0), include.mean = FALSE),
                   variance.model = list(model = 'sGARCH', garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
                   distribution = 'norm')

fit_01 <- ugarchfit(spec, serie, solver = 'hybrid')

print(fit_01@fit$coef)
```


```{r}
#meu
set.seed(123)

est_ar1garch1 = function(Y){
  calc_ar1garch1 = function(Y, param){
    phi = param[1]
    omega = param[2]
    alpha = param[3]
    beta = param[4]
    
    n = length(Y)
    r = Y[-1] - phi*Y[-n]
    r = c(0, r)
    sigma2 = rep(0, n)
    sigma2[1] = var(Y)
    ll = rep(0,n)
    
    #r = rep(0, n)
    
    for(i in 2:n){
      #r[i] = Y[i] - phi*Y[i-1]
      sigma2[i] = omega + alpha*(r[i-1])^2 + beta*(sigma2[i-1])
      ll[i] = -log(sigma2[i]) - ((r[i])^2)/(sigma2[i])
    }
    resultado = -sum(ll)
    return(resultado)
  }
  
  modelo = optim(par = c(0.04, 0.7, 0.1, .7), fn = calc_ar1garch1, Y = scale(Y))$par |> as.data.frame() |> t()
  row.names(modelo) = NULL
  colnames(modelo) = c("ar1", "omega", "alpha1", "beta1")
  return(modelo)
}

fit_02 = est_ar1garch1(serie)

print(cbind(modelo = c("ugarch", "meu"), rbind(fit_01@fit$coef, fit_02)))
```

```{r}
#Lucas
estima_ar1_garch11 <- function(y, params){
  omega <- params[2]
  alpha <- params[3]
  beta <- params[4]
  phi <- params[1]
  n <- length(y)
  
  r <- rep(0, n)
  sigma2 <- rep(0, n)
  llk <- rep(0, n)
  sigma2[1] <- var(r)
  for (i in 2:n){
    r[i] <- y[i] - phi*y[i-1]
    sigma2[i] <- omega + alpha*r[i-1]^2 + beta*sigma2[i-1]
    llk[i] <- -log(omega + alpha*r[i-1]^2 + beta*sigma2[i-1])-
      (y[i] - phi*y[i-1])^2/(omega + alpha*r[i-1]^2 + beta*sigma2[i-1])
  }
  llk <- sum(llk)
  return(-llk)
}

fit_03 = optim(par = c(0.04, 0.7, 0.1, .7), fn = estima_ar1_garch11, y = scale(serie, center = T, scale = T))$par |> as.data.frame() |> t()
rownames(fit_03) = NULL
colnames(fit_03) = c("ar1", "omega", "alpha1", "beta1")

print(cbind(modelo = c("ugarch", "meu", "lucas"), rbind(fit_01@fit$coef, fit_02, fit_03)))
```

```{r}
estima_ar1_garch11 <- function(y, params) {
  omega <- params[2]
  alpha <- params[3]
  beta <- params[4]
  phi <- params[1]
  n <- length(y)

  r <- rep(0, n)
  sigma2 <- rep(0, n)
  llk <- rep(0, n)
  sigma2[1] <- var(y)

  for (i in 2:n) {
    r[i] <- y[i] - phi * y[i - 1]
    sigma2[i] <- omega + alpha * (r[i - 1]^2) + beta * sigma2[i - 1]
    llk[i] <- dnorm(y[i], mean = phi * y[i - 1], sd = sqrt(sigma2[i]), log = TRUE)
  }
  llk <- sum(llk)
  return(-llk)
}

fit_03 <- optim(par = c(0.7, 0.04, 0.1, 0.7), fn = estima_ar1_garch11, y = scale(serie))$par |> as.data.frame() |>  t()

rownames(fit_03) = NULL
colnames(fit_03) = c("ar1", "omega", "alpha1", "beta1")

print(cbind(modelo = c("ugarch", "meu", "lucas"), rbind(fit_01@fit$coef, fit_02, fit_03)))
```
